claim: Okuda coupling route (patterning + growth + division + T1) reproduces tubulation/undulation, unchanged
rationale: control and Track-B reproduction target: the full coupled monolayer is Okuda's tubulation recipe

claim: removing morphogen diffusion kills the Turing prepattern, so growth is uniform and no tubes form
rationale: coupling (chi) needs a patterned field; without diffusion no spatial gradient can localize a tube

claim: removing patterned growth leaves mechanics-only, collapsing to the sphere null
rationale: growth is the presumed driver of protrusion; its removal should return the rigid-ball null

claim: without T1 reconnection the sheet cannot remodel topology, so tubes cannot elongate or branch
rationale: tests whether topological remodeling is necessary for the Okuda morphology or merely cosmetic

claim: growth without cell division still bulges into a protrusion
rationale: genuinely uncertain: does area growth alone deform the sheet, or is division required to add cells into the tube

claim: removing the cell-geometry operator degrades the force integration and suppresses protrusion
rationale: maps whether cell_geometry_3d is load-bearing for deformation in the coupled route

claim: superimposing uniform inflation on the patterned route inflates the whole vesicle and amplifies peak protrusion
rationale: combination Okuda never tried: does uniform pressure add to or wash out the patterned tube

claim: the round-33 driven+forced recipe reproduces a forced thick tube (mech_p_ratio ~3)
rationale: second control/Track-B anchor: a distinct forced-protrusion recipe, unmeasured soundly, anchors the parent-1 knockouts

claim: removing patterned growth from the forced recipe drops it to mechanics-only, no protrusion
rationale: isolates whether growth or the forcing carries the parent-1 protrusion

claim: without T1 the forced recipe cannot form a discrete tube
rationale: cross-checks the T1 necessity claim on a second, forced spine

claim: removing neighbor tracking breaks the mechanical coupling and reduces peak protrusion
rationale: maps whether cell_adjacency is necessary for coherent force transmission in the forced recipe

claim: adding uniform inflation to the already-forced recipe raises peak protrusion further
rationale: extremum: stacks two protrusion drivers to test whether the forcing saturates or adds
